## Where to ask

- **A bug or a feature idea:** open an issue; the forms ask only for what is needed.
- **A general question, or "has anyone done this?":** the Google Group, https://groups.google.com/g/open-source-cad
- **A security problem:** do not post it in public. Use the private route in SECURITY.md.
- **How support works, in full:** SUPPORT.md in the repository.
